scope: Static manifest 2D footprint audit plus actual garage FBX convex hull; NOT live-map terrain/Unity verification.
limitations: Convex hull includes every mesh and may fill empty garage yard/concavities.
Roofs use conservative 2D eave envelopes; height separation is not tested.
House attachments, foundation extensions, stairs and actual generated FBX geometry are not audited.
Live ground burial, Unity FBX import handedness and collider clearance are NOT verified.

garage.transform: local=(Blender x,-y); world x=wx+cos(yaw)*x+sin(yaw)*z; world z=wz-sin(yaw)*x+cos(yaw)*z

existing_review_negative_blender_yaw.note: env_auto_bpy.py applies Blender -yaw; under x,-y mapping that is the opposite Unity yaw. Included separately without changing source.

review_ground.scope: REVIEW GEOMETRY ONLY; not the actual map terrain, Unity scene, or gameplay collision.
review_ground.method: Boundary subdivisions <=0.25m plus <=0.25m world grid inside each body polygon and centroid; exact height on generated [a,d,c]/[a,c,b] triangles; maximum with all containing source-lot pads.
